messages.subject: "object not found error using knitr HTML
parts:
Hi, please forgive my complete novice status. 

I have encountered this error trying to use my own dataset and knitrHTML. I have spent two days looking for answers to this question and tried all the answers I could find, but to be honest a lot of the referenced solutions I simply don't understand what I am looking for.

I create a new project, set the working directory, 
"~/Desktop/R/decentration

I load the dataset ( called decentration in my example) attach it in Studio, save this script into the working directory and then open an Markdown session.

I select Knitr from the packages and it shows this in the console:
library("knitr", lib.loc="/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library")

I create a simple code:

```{r}
summary(decentration)
getwd()
```
 > getwd()
[1] "/Users/GaryWork/Desktop/R/decentration"

and run it. It works perfectly in the console and I see all the data, but when I press knitr i get this error message:



I have only this morning run the updates for the latest versions of R, RStudio and Knitr and I still cannot figure out a solution.

Please could somebody explain it to me in ver simple step by step fashion as I have tried everything else suggest on github and stack overflow and still no luck.

Thanks
